name: codex-url-vault
description: Local URL library with a native macOS app, task-oriented MCP tools, a card-based Codex Browser/IAB viewer, and Brave current-page capture.

interface.shortDescription: Use one local URL Vault from macOS, MCP, or Codex IAB.
interface.longDescription: A local URL library with a SwiftUI app, task-oriented stdio MCP tools, a responsive card-based Viewer for Codex Browser/IAB, and a Bitwarden-style Brave capture extension backed by a native Rust host.
defaultPrompt: Open Codex URL Vault and show my saved URLs.
Show Codex URL Vault inside Codex Browser/IAB, then find or save URLs for my current task.
Capture the current Brave page in Codex URL Vault.
